newsitem.title: BURKINA FASO: Police break up Burkina Faso student protest.
newsitem.headline: Police break up Burkina Faso student protest.

text.p: Police in Burkina Faso fired teargas on Saturday to break up a student demonstration in the West African nation's capital Ouagadougou, witnesses said.
The students were trying to march to the presidential palace to demand the release of two student leaders arrested on Friday, the witnesses added.

The National Association of Burkinabe Students (ANEB) called a strike from last Wednesday to back demands ranging from allowances for students not on formal grants to cheaper bus fares and improved food in the university restaurant.
